androidx.preference.Preference.app:title: Approve folders once
androidx.preference.Preference.app:summary: The app can reuse access to folders you select. It will not request access to all files on the device.

androidx.preference.Preference.app:title: Add Folder
androidx.preference.Preference.app:summary: Choose a folder to allow file operations such as renaming

androidx.preference.Preference.app:title: Downloads folder
androidx.preference.Preference.app:summary: Android 11 and newer does not allow selecting the Downloads folder itself. You can select a subfolder, or grant access to an individual file when renaming.
